S427-AC-003.text: - **S427-AC-003:** Required Windows launch evidence: SYSTEM/worker/repair identities and ACLs; real RAM backing/mapping; Docker pipe/backend denial; subscription retention; exact CLI capabilities; six-chapter native DAG; a complete coding workflow; stress at the configured shared capacity including replenishment, plus the separate exact four-worker Windows queue benchmark; Oracle storm/reaper; cancellation/crash/reboot; independent repair/promotion/rollback; hardware/desktop-heap/48-hour monitoring.

S427-DOCKER-001.text: - **S427-DOCKER-001:** Maintain a persistent prepared-container pool managed by the protected controller. Cold `create`/`start` occurs only in bounded background replenishment. Normal test jobs acquire a previously verified, unused matching prepared container; an empty pool records a wait/request and cannot fall back to inline cold creation. Prepared means actual running readiness plus exact image/policy/ownership attestation, not a registry label alone.

S427-DOCKER-003.text: - **S427-DOCKER-003:** A prepared container serves one attempt only. After source injection/execution, remove it and its scratch; never return a contaminated instance to the pool. Replenishment uses the exact immutable allowlisted image SHA and captured policy. Prepared, preparing and active containers count against the same hardware/seat budget as native jobs.

S427-DOCKER-006.text: - **S427-DOCKER-006:** Record background preparation duration separately from queue wait, handoff and test-ready latency. Retain original request time; never reset clocks to hide a miss. Warm startup ≤1.5 seconds remains the optimization target; the accepted historical 4.85-second cold creation belongs to replenishment, not the foreground job path. See Chapter 16 for acceptance disposition.

S427-OPS-015.text: - **S427-OPS-015:** Expose one acceptance dashboard containing every mandatory requirement, latest exact artifact hash, platform, revision and outstanding action. Missing, stale, unexecuted or wrong-platform evidence prevents aggregate full acceptance.

S427-PERF-001.text: - **S427-PERF-001:** The owner accepts the reported measurements as useful operating ranges: ten-process queue acquisition maximum **29.347 ms**, knowledge authenticated MCP mean **7.731 ms** (backend mean **4.100 ms**) and historical cold Docker creation **4.85 seconds**. These are accepted observations, not invented universal maxima, percentile promises or native Windows certification. The old 5 ms/1.5-second values remain optimization targets with the scopes below.

S427-PERF-004.text: - **S427-PERF-004:** Cold Docker preparation is accepted maintenance overhead. Normal jobs SHALL use the persistent prepared pool; no inline cold fallback. Record queue/request-to-test and prepared-handoff timing honestly; a pool miss is visible waiting, not a fake ≤1.5-second success. Improve warm handoff toward ≤1.5 seconds while preserving configured hardware admission, resource and isolation gates. The prior 0.486536-second warm fixture is evidence for that fixture only.

S427-PERF-005.text: - **S427-PERF-005:** The owner amendment does not waive ≤30-second test+collection, knowledge index ≤4×/RSS <256 MiB, Warden 50 MiB/5%, native desktop heap <15%, 48-hour handle stability, or independent observation/recovery timing. Each needs its own measured disposition. Do not interpret “these numbers are acceptable” as a blanket exemption from other requirements.

S427-SRE-002.text: - **S427-SRE-002:** Apply amended FR009: non-running rows retaining lease authority or pending jobs with exhausted ordinary-failure budgets establish structural collapse. Ordinary historical `FAILED` rows, cancellation and explicit task holds do not freeze unrelated work. Contain confirmed structural failure and preserve immutable diagnostic evidence before bounded recovery.
